title: Your first trade for Tuesday, December 11
text:
The " Fast Money " traders shared their first moves for the market open.
Tim Seymour was a buyer of FedEx .
Carter Worth was a buyer of the Short Term Treasury Bond ETF .
Steve Grasso was a buyer of the Utilities ETF .
Guy Adami was a buyer of Twitter .
